Class ContextAnnotationFormatter

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.context.ContextAnnotationFormatter
public final class ContextAnnotationFormatter extends Object
Standardized context annotation and tooltip formatter for IDE project and file views.

Provides consistent formatting across all IDE plugins (NetBeans, IntelliJ, Desktop):

  • Directories / Packages / Folders: Bracketed resource counts per session (e.g. [4] or [4][1]).
  • Files: Single session displays the session nickname in parentheses (e.g. (Intellij)), while multiple sessions display the active session count (e.g. (3)).

anahata

      public static String formatAnnotation(Map<Agi,Integer> sessionCounts, boolean isDirectory)
      Formats context counts into clean text annotations for IDE labels or location strings.
      Parameters:
      sessionCounts - Map of active sessions to their respective resource counts.
      isDirectory - True if the annotated node represents a directory, package, or container folder.
      Returns:
      The formatted annotation string (e.g. "[4]" or "(Intellij)"), or null if empty.
